connectorUiConfig.title: Entra ID Assets (via MS Graph)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Microsoft Entra assets include users, groups, applications, service principals and devices, together with their membership and ownership relationships. Collect this inventory in Microsoft Sentinel with weekly snapshots and hourly changefeeds where supported.

parameters.content:
### OAuth setup
- In the [Entra admin center](https://entra.microsoft.com), use the workspace's deployment tenant. Go to **App registrations > New registration** and register a **Single tenant** app. No redirect URI is required.
- Copy the **Application (client) ID** from Overview. Do not use the Object ID.
- Under **API permissions > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions** (not Delegated permissions), add the permissions below and select **Grant admin consent**.
- Under **Certificates & secrets > Client secrets > New client secret**, create a secret and copy its **Value**, not its Secret ID. Store it securely and rotate it before expiration.

**Application permissions:** `Application.Read.All`, `Device.Read.All`, `Group.Read.All`, `GroupMember.Read.All`, `OrgContact.Read.All`, `User.Read.All`, `User-LifeCycleInfo.Read.All`, `Organization.Read.All`, `RoleManagement.Read.Directory`, `RoleEligibilitySchedule.Read.Directory`, `PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.Read.AzureADGroup`. Add `Member.Read.Hidden` for hidden memberships. PIM requires applicable licensing.

**Preview:** Includes a Graph beta endpoint; unsupported for production applications.

**Weekly snapshot-only tables:** EntraOrganizationsV5_CL, EntraMembersV5_CL, EntraOwnersV5_CL, EntraGroupMembershipsV5_CL, EntraSponsorsV5_CL and EntraEligibleMembersV5_CL have no changefeed configured and receive only weekly snapshots, not hourly updates.

**Warning:** Sponsors, GroupMemberships and EligibleMembers snapshots may take up to 5 days in large tenants, or longer with throttling. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed maximum or SLA; early rows do not indicate completion.

**Eligibility licensing:** Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance is required. If eligibility fails, other collectors may still be connected; verify their deployment status.
